q: What does this SEO blog cover?
a: The articles cover technical SEO, search intent, content strategy, local SEO, e-commerce and how to measure organic search.

q: Where should a beginner start learning SEO?
a: Start with how search engines crawl and index pages, then learn search intent, useful content and Search Console reporting. Apply each concept to a real page.

q: Is technical SEO more important than content?
a: Neither is universally more important. Technical issues can prevent good pages from being found, while a healthy site still needs content that answers a real search.

q: How can I find content ideas for my business?
a: Use customer questions, Search Console queries, sales conversations and competing search results. Prioritise topics that help a buyer make a decision.

q: How often should I update SEO content?
a: Review pages when facts, products or search intent change. Update useful information and remove inaccuracies rather than changing dates or wording without substance.

q: How do I know whether a blog article works?
a: Check relevant search queries, engaged visits and the next actions readers take. A post that supports a high-intent service page can be valuable even without large traffic.
